description: Lightweight LLM-based English and Japanese TTS family built on MioCodec, supporting low-latency speech generation and zero-shot voice cloning from short reference audio.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Enable stochastic token sampling; default comes from model generation config, falling back to true.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Token sampling temperature in [0, 2]; default comes from model generation config, falling back to 0.8.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Token top-k sampling limit; default comes from model generation config, falling back to 50.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Token nucleus sampling limit in [0, 1]; default comes from model generation config, falling back to 1.0.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Token repetition penalty in [1, 1.5]; default comes from model generation config, falling back to 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed; omitted value uses a random seed.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Per-request long-form text chunk size in Unicode codepoints; overrides session text_chunk_size. Default session value is 180.

request.name: best_of_n
request.description: Generate n candidates for this request; overrides session best_of_n_default and is capped by session best_of_n_max.

request.name: best_of_n_enabled
request.description: Enable or disable best-of-N candidate selection for this request; overrides session best_of_n_enabled.

request.name: best_of_n_language
request.description: Language used when scoring best-of-N candidates for this request; overrides session best_of_n_language.

session.name: codec_path
session.description: MioCodec model directory used by MioTTS acoustic decoding; default is the sibling MioCodec package path when present.

session.name: text_chunk_size
session.description: Default long-form text chunk size in Unicode codepoints; default 180.

session.name: best_of_n_enabled
session.description: Enable best-of-N candidate selection by default.

session.name: best_of_n_language
session.description: Default language used when scoring best-of-N candidates.

session.name: best_of_n_asr_path
session.description: Qwen3-ASR model directory used by best-of-N scoring; default is sibling Qwen3-ASR-0.6B when present.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: MioTTS language-model matmul and WavLM weight storage type; default native.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: MioTTS language-model weight context size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MioTTS language-model prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MioTTS language-model decode graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: MioCodec decoder weight context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: codec_constant_context_mb
session.description: MioCodec decoder constant tensor context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: global_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MioCodec global reference encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: wave_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MioCodec wave decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 512.
